g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Check ChatGPT's explanations of basic terminology against references from books or papers
found online. → Get answers from ChatGPT that are logically sound and correct, especially
for high-level questions where errors are hard to detect.
